styles.name: editorial
styles.label: Editorial (teardowns)
styles.description: Grey canvas, giant lowercase display words, red script signature on cover and close, real product / ad / source crops in every photo zone, functional header and footer strip. Farrice's default for teardowns and any post that carries evidence.

styles.name: typographic
styles.label: Typographic (Premium Minimal)
styles.description: Pure type on canvas: masthead, field index, bold statement, three-route marker, one dark close. For posts with no evidence to show.
